items.text: $f$ isomorphism $\iff$ $f'$ isomorphism (flatness used: nilpotents and local rings matter).
Proof: $f'$ homeomorphism, coherent $\Rightarrow$ $f$ homeomorphism, coherent, $f_*\mathcal O_X$ quasi-coherent; flat base change:
g^*\bigl(\mathcal O_Y\to f_*\mathcal O_X\bigr)=\bigl(\mathcal O_{Y'}\to f'_*\mathcal O_{X'}\bigr)\ \text{iso}\ \Longrightarrow\ \mathcal O_Y\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }f_*\mathcal O_X
Base change $X\mapsto X'$ is faithful and conservative; $f$ monomorphism $\iff$ $f'$ monomorphism ($\Delta_f$ iso).
Descent of quasi-coherent sheaves and of subschemes
$g\colon S'\to S$ faithfully flat. $M\mapsto M'$ is exact and faithful:
\operatorname{Hom}_S(M,N)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Hom}_{S'}(M',N')\ \ \text{injective}
Which $u'\colon M'\to N'$ descend? $S''=S'\times_SS'$ with projections $p_1,p_2\colon S''\to S'$; $p_1^*M'\simeq p_2^*M'=M''$, so $p_1^*u'=p_2^*u'$ is necessary.
\operatorname{Hom}(M,N)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Hom}(M',N')\rightrightarrows\operatorname{Hom}(M'',N'')
If this is exact for all $M,N$, $g$ is a morphism of descent (1-descent) for quasi-coherent sheaves.
Theorem. $g$ faithfully flat and quasi-compact is a morphism of descent, indeed of effective descent.
Gluing data

A gluing (clutching) datum on $M'$ over $S'$: an isomorphism $c\colon p_1^*M'\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }p_2^*M'$ on $S''$. Functor $\mathrm{Mod}_S\to\mathrm{Mod}_{S'}^{CL}$; $g$ is of 1-descent iff it is fully faithful.
A gluing datum is effective if $M'$ with $c$ comes from some $M$ over $S$.
$S'''=S'\times_SS'\times_SS'$ with projections $q_{12},q_{23},q_{13}$ to $S''$: the modules $M'''_1,M'''_2,M'''_3$ (inverse images of $M'$).
This cocycle condition is necessary for effectivity; a gluing datum satisfying it is a descent datum.
Analogy: fibre spaces over an open cover

$S=\bigcup S_i$, $S'=\coprod S_i$, $S''=\coprod S_{ij}$, $S'''=\coprod S_{ijk}$: a fibre space $X'$ over $S'$ = family $X_i$; $c$ = isomorphisms $X_i|_{S_{ij}}\simeq X_j|_{S_{ij}}$; effective iff the transitivity holds on every $S_{ijk}$.
0-, 1-, 2-descent
0-descent: $\operatorname{Hom}(M,N)\to\operatorname{Hom}(M',N')$ injective (faithful functor). 1-descent: $\mathrm{Mod}_S\to\mathrm{Mod}^{CL}_{S'}$ fully faithful. 2-descent (effective descent):
g^*\colon\mathrm{Mod}_S\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }\mathrm{Mod}_{S'}^{DD}\qquad(\text{modules on }S'\text{ with descent data, taken with respect to }S)
Faithfully flat $\Rightarrow$ 0-descent; faithfully flat and quasi-compact $\Rightarrow$ 1-descent and 2-descent.
Proof of effective descent (idea)
Categories $F_S,F_{S'},F_{S''},F_{S'''}$ of quasi-coherent modules with base change functors: a cosimplicial category truncated in dimension two.
Local on $S$ for the Zariski topology: if descent holds over each $S_\alpha$ of an open cover, the $M_\alpha$ (unique up to unique isomorphism, by 1-descent) glue to an $M$.
Same for 1-descent: the $u_\alpha\colon M_\alpha\to N_\alpha$ are unique, hence glue.
The family $\coprod S_\alpha\to S$ is itself of effective descent for quasi-coherent modules.
